name: Darjeeling
tagline: Where the Himalayas meet the world's finest tea gardens
highlights: panoramic views of Kangchenjunga at sunrise
UNESCO toy train through misty tea estates

attractions.name: Tiger Hill Sunrise Viewpoint
attractions.description: At 2,590 metres, Tiger Hill is the highest point near Darjeeling and the most celebrated sunrise vantage point in the Himalayas. On clear mornings — most reliably between October and April — dawn light ignites the full Kangchenjunga massif (8,586 m) and, on the rarest days, the distant summit of Everest appears on the horizon 215 km away. Pre-dawn jeep convoys from town make this a daily pilgrimage.
attractions.whyVisit: Offers the most dramatic Himalayan sunrise panorama accessible by road anywhere in India.
attractions.bestTime: October to April, pre-dawn (4–5 AM departure from town)
attractions.imageQuery: Tiger Hill sunrise Kangchenjunga Darjeeling

attractions.name: Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (Toy Train)
attractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1999, the narrow-gauge Darjeeling Himalayan Railway has climbed from New Jalpaiguri to Darjeeling (88 km, 2,134 m elevation gain) since 1881. Its steam locos, Batasia Loop spiral, and zigzag reversal sections are engineering marvels. The joy-ride between Darjeeling and Ghum station takes just one hour but passes tea gardens, mountain ridges, and the Batasia Loop war memorial.
attractions.whyVisit: One of the world's great mountain railway journeys — a living piece of Victorian engineering heritage.
attractions.bestTime: October to November and March to May for clear skies
attractions.imageQuery: Darjeeling toy train steam locomotive tea garden

attractions.name: Kangchenjunga View from Observatory Hill
attractions.description: Observatory Hill (2,134 m) in the centre of Darjeeling town is sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists, and prayer flags stream from its summit shrine. The Mahakal Temple here is active and atmospheric, with devotees ringing bells at all hours. More importantly, the hill offers an unobstructed face-on view of Kangchenjunga — the world's third-highest peak — filling the northern skyline above the town's rooftops.
attractions.whyVisit: The most accessible in-town viewpoint for Kangchenjunga, combined with a genuine living temple.
attractions.bestTime: Early morning before clouds build
attractions.imageQuery: Observatory Hill Kangchenjunga Darjeeling temple

attractions.name: Happy Valley Tea Estate
attractions.description: Established in 1854 and now the only tea estate operating inside Darjeeling town, Happy Valley produces the celebrated muscatel first flush Darjeeling tea on ancient bushes planted over 160 years ago. Guided walks through the terraced gardens explain the plucking cycle, and the factory tour shows withering, rolling, oxidation, and firing. Visitors can taste and buy directly from the estate.
attractions.whyVisit: The only chance to walk through a genuine Darjeeling tea garden and watch tea processing under one roof.
attractions.bestTime: March to May for first flush plucking season
attractions.imageQuery: Happy Valley Tea Estate Darjeeling tea plucking

attractions.name: Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park
attractions.description: At 2,134 metres, this is Asia's highest altitude zoo and home to one of the world's most successful snow leopard breeding programmes. The park houses the endangered red panda in naturalistic forested enclosures, along with Himalayan wolves, Tibetan yaks, and clouded leopards. The zoo's conservation work with snow leopards has produced multiple successful births since the programme began in 1986.
attractions.whyVisit: The best place in India to see snow leopards and red pandas in a high-altitude naturalistic setting.
attractions.bestTime: October to March for active animals in cool weather
attractions.mapsSearch: Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park Darjeeling
attractions.imageQuery: snow leopard Darjeeling zoo Himalayan

attractions.name: Himalayan Mountaineering Institute
attractions.description: Founded in 1954, just a year after Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary's Everest summit, this institute trained generations of Indian mountaineers. The museum inside holds the original oxygen equipment, boots, and rucksack used by Tenzing on the 1953 Everest expedition, along with extensive exhibits on Himalayan peaks, climbing history, and glaciology. Tenzing Norgay's grave is in the adjacent grounds.
attractions.whyVisit: A pilgrimage site for mountaineering history, housing Tenzing's original Everest summit gear.
attractions.bestTime: Year-round; closed on Thursdays
attractions.imageQuery: Himalayan Mountaineering Institute Darjeeling Tenzing

attractions.name: Ghum Monastery (Yiga Choeling)
attractions.description: Built in 1850 near Ghum — the highest railway station in India at 2,258 m — Yiga Choeling is Darjeeling's oldest Gelugpa Buddhist monastery. Its prayer hall houses a 15-foot statue of the Maitreya (Future Buddha) and walls covered in intricate thangka paintings. The resident monks chant in the hall daily at dawn and dusk, filling the small space with a resonant, meditative atmosphere.
attractions.whyVisit: Darjeeling's oldest and most spiritually active monastery, perfectly combined with the toy train halt at Ghum.
attractions.bestTime: Early morning or evening during prayer sessions
attractions.imageQuery: Ghum monastery Darjeeling Buddhist prayer flags

attractions.name: Batasia Loop
attractions.description: Constructed in 1919 to reduce the gradient of the toy train descent from Ghum into Darjeeling, the Batasia Loop is a complete 360-degree spiral track that allows the train to lose altitude while staying within a small horizontal radius. A war memorial garden honouring Gorkha soldiers sits at the loop's centre, and the viewpoint here offers an unobstructed panorama of Darjeeling town against the Kangchenjunga backdrop.
attractions.whyVisit: A unique railway engineering landmark offering the best combined view of town, tea gardens, and Himalayas.
attractions.bestTime: Morning for clear mountain views
attractions.imageQuery: Batasia Loop toy train Darjeeling spiral

attractions.name: Rock Garden and Ganga Maya Park
attractions.description: Descending 10 km from Darjeeling town to an elevation of 1,400 m, the Rock Garden is built along a mountain stream with terraced waterfalls, flower beds, and viewing decks cut into the hillside. The adjacent Ganga Maya Park is quieter and more forested, with a small lake. The drive down through oak and rhododendron forest is itself scenic, passing tea gardens and small Gorkha villages.
attractions.whyVisit: A family-friendly garden escape with genuine waterfall scenery set on a forested mountainside.
attractions.bestTime: April to June for rhododendron bloom
attractions.imageQuery: Rock Garden Darjeeling waterfall terraced

attractions.name: Chowrasta (Mall Road)
attractions.description: The pedestrian-only Chowrasta square at the top of Darjeeling's Mall Road is the social hub of the entire hill station. Vendors sell Tibetan jewellery, woolens, and local snacks like churpi (dried yak cheese) and sel roti. The square's benches face a broad mountain panorama and are perpetually occupied by local Nepali families, tourists, and Tibetan traders. Gompu's Bar on the square is a Darjeeling institution since 1973.
attractions.whyVisit: The living cultural heart of Darjeeling, where the town's Nepali, Tibetan, and Bengali identities visibly converge.
attractions.bestTime: Late afternoon to evening
attractions.imageQuery: Chowrasta Mall Road Darjeeling market square

attractions.name: Mirik Lake
attractions.description: The centrepiece of the Mirik hill resort, 49 km from Darjeeling, is a calm lake ringed by silver oak, cardamom bushes, and neat gardens. A footbridge divides the lake, and pedal boats are available for hire. The surrounding hills are carpeted with tea gardens producing Mirik orange pekoe. The drive from Darjeeling passes through the most scenic sections of the Sikkim-West Bengal border ridgeline.
attractions.whyVisit: A peaceful alternative to crowded Darjeeling with a scenic lake and some of Bengal's finest tea gardens.
attractions.bestTime: October to December and March to May
attractions.imageQuery: Mirik Lake Darjeeling tea garden reflection

attractions.name: Darjeeling Market (Chowk Bazaar)
attractions.description: The lower Chowk Bazaar is where Darjeeling residents actually shop — a chaotic, atmospheric mix of vegetable vendors, spice traders, Tibetan butter tea stalls, and shops selling Himalayan herbs, lokta paper, and handmade carpets. The market is built on steep lanes where porters (locally called 'coolies') carry enormous loads in cane dokos (baskets), a scene unchanged for over a century.
attractions.whyVisit: An authentic, tourist-light market that reveals the working Himalayan town beneath Darjeeling's colonial surface.
attractions.bestTime: Weekday mornings when local trade is busiest
attractions.imageQuery: Chowk Bazaar Darjeeling local market Himalayan

attractions.name: Sandakphu Trek (Singalila Ridge)
attractions.description: At 3,636 metres, Sandakphu on the Singalila Ridge is the highest peak in West Bengal and offers what trekkers call the 'Sleeping Buddha' view — the silhouettes of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, and Kangchenjunga arranged in a line that resembles a reclining figure. The 4-5 day trek from Manebhanjan passes through rhododendron forests and Sherpa villages along the Nepal border.
attractions.whyVisit: The only place in the world where four of the five highest mountains on Earth are visible simultaneously.
attractions.bestTime: April to May for rhododendrons; October to November for crisp mountain views
attractions.imageQuery: Sandakphu summit Everest Kangchenjunga view

attractions.name: Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa)
attractions.description: Built by Japanese Buddhist monk Nichidatsu Fujii and inaugurated in 1992, this gleaming white stupa on Jalapahar Hill has four niches bearing golden Buddha statues in different postures representing birth, enlightenment, teaching, and death. The wide terrace around the pagoda looks directly north towards Kangchenjunga, and monks from the attached Japanese temple maintain the grounds.
attractions.whyVisit: A serene hilltop shrine combining outstanding mountain views with the quiet of a working Buddhist community.
attractions.bestTime: Sunset, when the white dome turns gold
attractions.mapsSearch: Peace Pagoda Shanti Stupa Darjeeling Jalapahar
attractions.imageQuery: Peace Pagoda Darjeeling white stupa mountain

attractions.name: Tonglu and Tumling (Singalila Foothills)
attractions.description: The first day's walk from Manebhanjan on the Sandakphu trail reaches the twin ridgeline villages of Tonglu (3,036 m) and Tumling — the latter just across the Nepal border. Both have basic trekkers' huts and offer their own clear-day views of the Kangchenjunga range. The trail passes through oak and rhododendron forest where red pandas are occasionally spotted at dawn.
attractions.whyVisit: A manageable one to two-day trek from Darjeeling with genuine Himalayan scenery and red panda habitat.
attractions.bestTime: April to May for rhododendron bloom
attractions.imageQuery: Tonglu trek rhododendron Singalila Darjeeling

attractions.name: Lebong Race Course
attractions.description: The highest racecourse in the world (elevation 1,980 m) and once the crown jewel of British sporting life in Darjeeling, Lebong Race Course opened in 1887. The oval track sits on a natural mountain shelf overlooking a deep valley and is no longer used for racing, but its grandstand, weigh-in rooms, and colonial infrastructure are remarkably intact. It now hosts Nepali cultural events and festivals.
attractions.whyVisit: A strikingly preserved piece of colonial sporting heritage perched on a Himalayan mountain shelf.
attractions.bestTime: Year-round; particularly atmospheric during local festivals
attractions.imageQuery: Lebong Race Course Darjeeling colonial heritage

attractions.name: Makaibari Tea Estate
attractions.description: Established in 1859, Makaibari is not only the world's oldest Darjeeling tea estate but also the first to achieve biodynamic and fair-trade certification. Its silver tips imperial tea holds the world record for the most expensive Darjeeling tea sold at auction. Visitors can stay in home-stay bungalows within the estate, walk the ancient garden, and watch hand-rolling of special grades in the factory.
attractions.whyVisit: The world's oldest and most decorated Darjeeling tea estate, with the option to stay overnight within the garden.
attractions.bestTime: March to June for first and second flush
attractions.imageQuery: Makaibari Tea Estate Kurseong biodynamic garden

attractions.name: Nightingale Park
attractions.description: Laid out in the 1920s around a colonial bungalow adjacent to Chowrasta, Nightingale Park is a terraced ornamental garden with immaculate flower beds and lawns at an elevation that gives uninterrupted views toward Kanchenjunga. The park is quiet, well-maintained by the Darjeeling municipality, and a favourite escape from the crowded bazaar just minutes away.
attractions.whyVisit: A calm, flower-filled colonial garden with direct Kangchenjunga views, right in the heart of town.
attractions.bestTime: Spring (April to May) for peak flower display
attractions.imageQuery: Nightingale Park Darjeeling flowers garden

attractions.name: Tenzing Rock, Lebong
attractions.description: A large granite outcrop above the Lebong valley used by the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute since the 1950s as a training face for student mountaineers, Tenzing Rock is named for the Everest summiteer who lived and trained in Darjeeling. The routes on the boulder vary from beginner traverses to overhanging problems. The surrounding scrub forest has Bengal tiger sightings on record, though rare.
attractions.whyVisit: The only spot in Darjeeling for beginner rock climbing with a direct historical link to Tenzing Norgay.
attractions.bestTime: October to May
attractions.imageQuery: Tenzing Rock Darjeeling rock climbing granite

attractions.name: St. Andrew's Church
attractions.description: Built in 1843 to serve the Scottish community of early Darjeeling, St. Andrew's is the oldest European church in the town. The stone Gothic structure sits in a walled cemetery whose headstones — many from the 1840s–1880s — tell the story of early colonial Darjeeling through the names of soldiers, planters, and administrators. The interior retains original stained glass and wooden pews.
attractions.whyVisit: Darjeeling's oldest building, with a cemetery that reads as a social history of the hill station's founding.
attractions.bestTime: Year-round; Sunday morning service is atmospheric
attractions.imageQuery: St Andrews Church Darjeeling colonial stone

attractions.name: Kalimpong (day trip)
attractions.description: Perched on a ridge at 1,250 metres, 51 km from Darjeeling, Kalimpong was once a major Silk Road trading post between India and Tibet. Today it is famous for orchid nurseries producing over 300 varieties, the Zang Dhok Palri Phodang monastery, and the Tharpachen monastery with its views over the Teesta Valley. Cactus Nursery and Himalayan Garden are internationally renowned.
attractions.whyVisit: A quieter hill town with a distinct Tibetan trading-post character and the finest orchid nurseries in Northeast India.
attractions.bestTime: October to March
attractions.mapsSearch: Kalimpong West Bengal day trip from Darjeeling
attractions.imageQuery: Kalimpong orchid nursery monastery West Bengal

attractions.name: Deolo Hill, Kalimpong
attractions.description: The highest point in Kalimpong at 1,704 metres, Deolo Hill has a well-maintained park at its summit with a children's play area and a lodge. The panoramic view takes in the full Kangchenjunga range to the north and the Teesta River zigzagging through its deeply incised valley far below. On very clear days, the plains of Bangladesh are visible to the south.
attractions.whyVisit: The single best 360-degree Himalayan and valley viewpoint accessible by road from Darjeeling in a day trip.
attractions.bestTime: October to November for crystalline visibility
attractions.imageQuery: Deolo Hill Kalimpong Kangchenjunga panorama

attractions.name: Senchal Lake and Wildlife Sanctuary
attractions.description: The source of Darjeeling's drinking water since the British era, Senchal Lake at 2,560 metres sits within a compact wildlife sanctuary just 10 km from town. The sanctuary harbours leopard, barking deer, Himalayan black bear, and an exceptional variety of Himalayan birds including the blood pheasant. The old British-era pump house and distribution infrastructure is still operational.
attractions.whyVisit: A little-visited high-altitude wildlife refuge that also functions as a living Victorian water-engineering monument.
attractions.bestTime: October to April; dawn for birding
attractions.imageQuery: Senchal Lake Darjeeling reservoir wildlife

attractions.name: Risheehat and Balasun River Walk
attractions.description: Below Darjeeling, at 1,100 metres, the Balasun River runs through subtropical forest where the mountain flora transitions suddenly to jungle — bamboo, tree ferns, and wild banana replace the oaks of the higher slopes. The Risheehat area has gentle river-bank paths rarely visited by tourists, passes through small Gorkha homesteads growing cardamom and large-leaf tea, and is excellent for birding.
attractions.whyVisit: A completely overlooked lower-elevation escape from Darjeeling's crowds with rich subtropical bird life.
attractions.bestTime: October to April
attractions.imageQuery: Balasun River Darjeeling forest subtropical walk

attractions.name: Lopchu Tea Estate
attractions.description: Located between Darjeeling and Siliguri at just 700 metres elevation, the Lopchu estate grows the warming, thick-bodied 'bolder' grade Darjeeling teas often blended into chai. Unlike the famous high-altitude gardens, Lopchu receives almost no tourist traffic and the factory manager will typically show a genuine, working industrial-scale tea operation without the curated tourist experience of estates near town.
attractions.whyVisit: An authentic working tea factory rarely visited by tourists, showing the commercial-grade side of Darjeeling tea.
attractions.bestTime: Year-round; active plucking March to November
attractions.imageQuery: Lopchu tea estate Darjeeling factory low-altitude
